title: What is known about 1RB---_1RC1RE_1LD0LE_1RF0LC_0RD0RA_0RB1RD
description: Proof status of the six-state BB(6) holdout 1RB---_1RC1RE_1LD0LE_1RF0LC_0RD0RA_0RB1RD.
intro: Nobody knows whether this six-state, two-symbol Turing machine halts when started on a blank tape: it is one of the holdouts left open by the bbchallenge project. This page lists what has been established about it, sorted by what each result rests on.
verdict: The question is open. The run is a sequence of phases: a counter n becomes 10·(n div 3) + d, where the residue of n mod 3 and a word P of blocks to its left decide d and the next word. Lean proves the rounds of a phase for all lengths. No halting transition was found in the word dynamics (trusted, by simulation), so the machine may well run forever, but the word dynamics is unbounded and not understood.

claims.title: The halting configurations
claims.text: The machine stops exactly when it reads the symbol of a halting transition (A1); the generated statement covers every configuration.

claims.title: No halt in the first 10,000 steps
claims.text: The list simulator of the shared library, proved to agree with the machine's semantics, runs 10,000 steps from blank tape without a halt, evaluated by Lean's kernel.

claims.title: No halt in the first 10<sup>7</sup> steps
claims.text: The same run, evaluated by compiled code.

claims.title: No halt in the first 10<sup>9</sup> steps
claims.text: The C simulator tools/c/triage.c runs 109 steps without a halt; at the end 85,710 cells have been visited and 49,084 of them hold a 1.

claims.title: Growth shape: fixed/sqrt
claims.text: Left of the start, the visited part of the tape stopped growing in the second half of the run (bounded so far, or growing so slowly that no record fell in the last half). Right of the start it grows like the square root of the step count, the signature of a head sweeping back and forth across the whole tape and adding a cell or a few at the end of each sweep (a bouncer-like shape) (fitted exponent 0.531).

claims.title: The rounds of a phase
claims.text: The start of a phase, one round (three 1s of the counter become five pairs 01), and any number of rounds at once, for every count and every word P.

claims.title: The phase map agrees with the machine
claims.text: At all 7 transitions between the 8 phase starts of the first 4·10<sup>8</sup> steps (the last at step 195,362,811, n = 34,398) the measured word map predicts the next phase start.

claims.title: No halt in the explored word dynamics
claims.text: Exploring the word dynamics breadth first for every sequence of residues (600 words, the longest 194 cells): no transition halts, and every one returns to a phase start.

claims.title: The real orbit
claims.text: From the first phase start (step 49, P empty, n = 8), computed exactly: no halt in 3,000 phases (n then has 5,214 bits); 94 distinct words, the longest 89 cells.

claims.title: No halting piece in a symbolic search over every residue sequence
claims.text: A class is a phase start P 1^n 01010 A>0 in which n and every block of P of at least 20 words are free. A symbolic simulator (several free counts; it refuses any step whose outcome depends on them and the class is then split into pieces) runs each class to the next phase start, for all values at once and for every residue of n. In 25 minutes: 3,619 classes cut into 101,407 pieces, every piece reaches a phase start, none halts and none is undecided. The set is not closed: 891 classes were still queued and the stack of blocks in P keeps getting deeper (up to five free blocks; six with a threshold of 7 instead of 20, 2,418 classes, also no halt). On a random sample of 400 classes a plain simulator agrees in 16,900 piece runs and 2,400 class points.

claims.title: A two-sided search for chains of any length: no halting piece, not closed
claims.text: A second search keeps a window around the head (one or two big blocks on each side) and abstracts the tape beyond it, on both sides, by a successor relation on blocks, so that chains of big blocks of any length are covered. 7,011 classes explored (window of one block; 3,197 with two): none halts, none is undecided, but the queue keeps growing (97,624 classes). The obstacle is now the blocks shorter than the threshold of 7 words, which are kept cell by cell and form chains of any length; a lower threshold breaks the simulator's acceleration rules. This search itself has not been compared with a plain simulator. With a separate low threshold for the classes (every repeat of 4 or more words free) the search stalls too: no halting piece in 890 classes, but the queue grows faster than it is worked off and the coarser relation produces tapes the machine never makes, on which runs do not finish.

claims.title: No halt in the first 3.8·10<sup>60</sup> steps
claims.text: The accelerated simulator (exact; its jumps are rules checked by symbolic runs) follows the run from blank tape to 3.8·10<sup>60</sup> steps without a halt.
claims.where: holdouts/1RB0LE_1RC---_0RD0RE_1LE0RB_0LA0LF_0RC0LD/py/closure/paccel.py with BBM set to this machine, BBEV=1 BBMIRROR=1

claims.title: Probably nonhalting, for a structural reason not yet proved
claims.text: Unlike Antihydra-type machines, no halting word is known here, so there is no coin-flip argument for a halt. The word behaves like a stack of nested counters (a residue-0 phase absorbs its last block into the counter, the others push or edit blocks), and the explored part of it never halts; a proof would need an invariant on all reachable words.

claims.title: Does it halt from blank tape?
claims.text: It halts if and only if the word dynamics, driven by the residues mod 3 of the counter, reaches a halting word. None is known; proving that none is reachable needs an invariant for an unbounded word. The class search of 13 November finds no halting piece but does not close, because phases walk down chains of blocks of any length; a two-sided search that covers chains of big blocks does not close either, because short blocks are kept exactly. The next step is a search with a separate low threshold for the classes.

explainer.lede: Nobody knows yet. A counter grows by a factor of about 10/3 each phase, and its residues mod 3 edit a word of blocks on the tape. No halting word has been found, which points to nonhalting, but the words reachable are unbounded.

facts.text: per phase: the rounds of a phase are proved in Lean for every count.
of the word dynamics explored for every residue sequence: no halt.
No halt in the C simulator; 85,710 cells visited.
No halt, proved in Lean; the first 10,000 by the kernel alone.

sections.heading: Phases: a counter and a word
html: Stop the machine every time the head, in state A, is at the right end of the tape with the tape reading

a word P (ending in 0), a block of n 1s and the fixed end 01010. During a phase the head goes back and forth between the counter and the right end: each round takes three 1s from the counter and writes five pairs 01 at the right (Lean, for all counts). When fewer than three 1s are left, the residue n mod 3 decides what happens: the head goes on into P and edits its last blocks, and on the way back the pairs become the next counter. So n becomes 10·(n div 3) + d, where d and the next word depend only on P and n mod 3.

In the words, a residue-0 phase absorbs the last block of P into the counter (proved in Lean for the machines with factor 8/3), while the other residues push new blocks or edit the last ones, often through a smaller phase of the same kind run on a block of P. So P is a stack of nested counters.

sections.heading: Does any word halt?
html: The word map was measured by simulation (each pair of a word and a residue is run from three sample counts, which must agree). Exploring the word dynamics breadth first for every sequence of residues (600 words, the longest 194 cells): no transition halts, and every one returns to a phase start.
From the first phase start (step 49, P empty, n = 8), computed exactly: no halt in 3,000 phases (n then has 5,214 bits); 94 distinct words, the longest 89 cells.

So, unlike Antihydra-type machines, there is no known halting word and no probabilistic argument for a halt: the machine is plausibly nonhalting. A proof would need a description of every word the dynamics can reach, closed under all residues, together with the phase ends proved in Lean for each kind of word. That was not done here.

Related machines. 1RB---_0RC0RE_1RD1RF_1LE0LB_1RC0LD_1RC1RA and 1RB0LC_1RC1RE_1LA0LD_0RB0RA_1RB1RF_1RD--- (one table, relabelled) have the same kind of phase with factor 8/3: three 1s of the counter become four pairs instead of five.

sections.heading: The shape of the run
html: Left of the start, the visited part of the tape stopped growing in the second half of the run (bounded so far, or growing so slowly that no record fell in the last half). Right of the start it grows like the square root of the step count, the signature of a head sweeping back and forth across the whole tape and adding a cell or a few at the end of each sweep (a bouncer-like shape) (fitted exponent 0.531).
After 109 steps the tape spans 85,710 cells (11 left of the start, 67,834 right), with a density of 1s of 0.573.
These are measurements of one bounded run, sorted by tools/py/bbtools/triage.py; the macro structure behind them is the next thing to find.

sections.heading: Related machines
html: Other holdouts of the list of 608 that are tied to this one. The comparison of tables is exact; everything about runs was checked on the first 107 steps of each machine and is an observation, not a proof (holdouts/related.py, holdouts/related.json).

Same table as the machines below, started in another state. Renaming the states as shown turns this machine's table into the other one, the halting transition included. The other machine starts in its own state A, which is not this machine's A: its run from blank tape is the run of this table started in another state. These are different runs: in the first 107 steps of each, no configuration of this machine's run occurs in any of the others, even up to a shift of the tape. So each of these holdouts is its own halting question, and settling one does not settle another.

summary: A counter n multiplied by about 10/3 per phase, whose residue mod 3 edits a word P of blocks on the tape; no halting word found (a Collatz-type word dynamics, open).
